szoveg_eredeti:
Trade, tech and security tensions loom over carefully staged summit in Shenzhen

A screen at China's Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport promotes the upcoming Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders' meeting. © Reuters

SHANGHAI/HONG KONG/TOKYO -- China is hosting the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum in the southern tech hub of Shenzhen this week. The main leaders' summit will take place on Wednesday and Thursday, with U.S. President Donald Trump and Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi among the guests. A flurry of meetings is expected on the sidelines, including the first trilateral summit between Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian leader Vladimir Putin.
